title: Negative decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.dec.signed.add-sub: Subtracting a negative? Add the opposite. Same signs: add the sizes and keep the sign. Different signs: subtract the sizes; the answer takes the sign of the one farther from 0.
hints.dec.signed.mult-div: Multiply or divide as if there were no signs. Then: one negative makes it negative, two negatives make it positive.
hints.dec.signed: Same rules as integers. Add/subtract: sizes and the sign of the one farther from 0. Multiply/divide: one negative is negative, two are positive.

misconceptionMessages.dec.signed-wrong-sign: The size is right, but check the sign. With different signs, the answer takes the sign of the number farther from 0.
misconceptionMessages.dec.signed-mult-sign: The digits are right; check the sign. One negative makes the answer negative; two negatives make it positive.

sections.title: Add and subtract negative decimals
sections.objective: Use the integer rules with decimals: −3.5 + 1.2, 3.25 − (−1.4).
explain: Decimals follow the same sign rules as integers. Line up the points to work out the size.

visual.caption: −2.5 + 4: start at −2.5 and move 4 to the right.

sections.key: Same signs: add the sizes, keep the sign. Different signs: subtract the sizes; the answer takes the sign of the one farther from 0.

worked.note: 3.5 is farther from 0, and it's negative

sections.title: Multiply and divide negative decimals
sections.objective: Multiply and divide decimals with signs: −0.3 × 4, −0.48 ÷ (−0.6).
explain: Work out the digits the usual way: count places when multiplying; move both points when dividing by a decimal.
Then decide the sign, just like integers.
sections.key: Ignore the signs and multiply or divide. Then: one negative makes the answer negative; two negatives make it positive.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: All four operations with negative decimals, mixed.
